command: cd /work && ./clock && ls -la && cd crate && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 cargo test --locked --features sync,future
cd /work/crate && pwd && rg --files -g '*.md' -g 'Cargo.toml' -g '*toml' -g '*.rs' | head -100 && cat Cargo.toml

cd /work/crate && find src -type f | sort && find .github -type f | sort && cat rust-toolchain* 2>/dev/null; cat .cargo/config* 2>/dev/null; cat build.rs; sed -n '1,240p' src/policy.rs; sed -n '1,240p' src/ops.rs
cd /work/crate && cat .github/workflows/Lints.yml && cat .github/workflows/CI.yml && sed -n '1,250p' src/sync/segment.rs && sed -n '1,240p' src/common/time/instant.rs && wc -l src/*/*.rs
cd /work/crate && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 cargo clippy --locked --lib --tests --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings > /work/tmp/clippy.log 2>&1; code=$?; cat /work/tmp/clippy.log; exit "$code"

cd /work/crate && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 cargo fmt --all -- --check && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 cargo doc --locked --no-deps --features sync,future > /work/tmp/doc.log 2>&1; code=$?; cat /work/tmp/doc.log; exit "$code"

cd /work/crate && grep -nE '^    (pub|async |fn |pub\(crate\))|expire_after|TODO|FIXME' src/sync/base_cache.rs | head -180 && sed -n '1,260p' src/sync/value_initializer.rs && sed -n '1,230p' src/common/concurrent/entry_info.rs && sed -n '1760,2060p' src/sync/cache.rs && cat /work/clock
cd /work/crate && sed -n '180,440p' src/sync/base_cache.rs && sed -n '480,718p' src/sync/base_cache.rs && sed -n '1390,1775p' src/sync/base_cache.rs && sed -n '2190,2298p' src/sync/base_cache.rs
cd /work/crate && sed -n '230,400p' src/policy.rs && sed -n '2560,2720p' src/sync/base_cache.rs && sed -n '2840,3294p' src/sync/base_cache.rs && sed -n '1,260p' src/future/value_initializer.rs

cd /work/crate && cat examples/jittered_expiry_policy_sync.rs && cat examples/reinsert_expired_entries_sync.rs && sed -n '850,1100p' src/sync/cache.rs && sed -n '1500,1735p' src/sync/cache.rs && sed -n '690,860p' src/sync/segment.rs && sed -n '1,210p' src/common/concurrent/arc.rs

cd /work/crate && cat src/sync/invalidator.rs && cat src/common/iter.rs && sed -n '1,250p' src/future/housekeeper.rs && sed -n '1130,1325p' src/sync/base_cache.rs && sed -n '1,210p' src/sync/builder.rs

cd /work/crate && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 cargo check --locked --no-default-features && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 rustc --version --verbose && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 cargo --version && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 rustup toolchain list && /work/clock
cd /work/crate && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 cargo test --locked --all-features > /work/tmp/all-features.log 2>&1; code=$?; tail -100 /work/tmp/all-features.log; exit "$code"

cd /work/crate && sed -n '1,230p' src/lib.rs && sed -n '1,270p' src/common/timer_wheel.rs && sed -n '1,330p' src/cht/segment.rs && cat src/common/time/clock.rs && sed -n '190,222p' src/sync/entry_selector.rs && sed -n '735,758p' src/sync/entry_selector.rs

cd /work/crate && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 rustc --version --verbose && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 cargo --version && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 rustup toolchain list && /work/clock && grep -n 'test result:' /work/tmp/all-features.log && grep -nE 'policy_gen|set_policy_gen' src/future/base_cache.rs && nl -ba src/common/concurrent/entry_info.rs | sed -n '88,124p' && nl -ba src/sync/base_cache.rs | sed -n '680,715p' && nl -ba src/future/base_cache.rs | sed -n '720,790p'

cd /work/crate && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc --locked --no-deps --features sync,future > /work/tmp/strict-doc.log 2>&1; code=$?; cat /work/tmp/strict-doc.log; exit "$code"

cd /work/crate && cat src/future/notifier.rs && cat src/notification/notifier.rs && cat src/sync/key_lock.rs && sed -n '250,460p' src/future/value_initializer.rs && sed -n '2360,2510p' src/sync/base_cache.rs && sed -n '790,845p' src/future/base_cache.rs && sed -n '1585,1628p' src/future/base_cache.rs && grep -nE 'pub fn |pub async fn ' src/sync/entry_selector.rs src/future/entry_selector.rs

cd /work/crate && sed -n '500,690p' src/future/base_cache.rs && sed -n '1270,1455p' src/future/cache.rs && sed -n '75,176p' src/future/entry_selector.rs && sed -n '249,310p' src/sync/value_initializer.rs && sed -n '228,260p' src/future/entry_selector.rs

cd /work/crate && nl -ba src/future/value_initializer.rs | sed -n '330,388p' && nl -ba src/future/value_initializer.rs | sed -n '465,535p' && sed -n '1350,1455p' src/sync/cache.rs && sed -n '1520,1700p' src/future/cache.rs && cat src/common/entry.rs && cat src/notification.rs && sed -n '1,150p' README.md && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f -iname '*build*' -o -iname '*readme*'

cd /work/crate && sed -n '1065,1097p' src/sync/entry_selector.rs && grep -n -A35 'get_or_try_insert_with_hash_by_ref_and_fun' src/future/cache.rs && sed -n '1160,1255p' src/sync/cache.rs && grep -nE 'get_with_hash\([^\n]*false\)|get_with_hash\(key, hash, false' src/sync/cache.rs src/future/cache.rs && cat tests/entry_api_sync.rs

cd /work/crate && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 cargo test --locked --features future > /work/tmp/future-only.log 2>&1; code=$?; grep 'test result:' /work/tmp/future-only.log; tail -8 /work/tmp/future-only.log; exit "$code"

cd /work/crate && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 cargo test --locked --features sync > /work/tmp/sync-only.log 2>&1; code=$?; grep 'test result:' /work/tmp/sync-only.log; tail -8 /work/tmp/sync-only.log; exit "$code"

cd /work/crate && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 RUSTDOCFLAGS='--cfg docsrs' cargo +nightly-2026-10-01 doc --locked --no-deps --features sync,future > /work/tmp/nightly-doc.log 2>&1; code=$?; cat /work/tmp/nightly-doc.log; exit "$code"

cd /work/tmp/review-crate && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 cargo test --release --locked --features sync,future --test review_regressions -- --nocapture > /work/tmp/release-regressions.log 2>&1; code=$?; tail -135 /work/tmp/release-regressions.log; /work/clock; exit "$code"

cd /work && ./clock && cd crate && nl -ba src/sync/cache.rs | sed -n '1408,1430p' && nl -ba src/sync/base_cache.rs | sed -n '1450,1478p' && nl -ba src/future/base_cache.rs | sed -n '1600,1620p' && nl -ba src/future/base_cache.rs | sed -n '815,838p' && grep -n -A5 -B5 '#\[ignore\]' src/sync/cache.rs src/sync/segment.rs && grep -nE 'fn (compute_with|try_compute_with)|and_compute_with|Barrier' src/future/cache.rs | tail -45 && diff -qr /work/crate/src /work/tmp/review-crate/src && wc -l /work/tmp/review-crate/tests/review_regressions.rs

cd /work/crate && sed -n '4510,4690p' src/future/cache.rs && sed -n '640,735p' README.md && grep -nE '^fn |^async fn ' /work/tmp/review-crate/tests/review_regressions.rs && diff -qr /work/crate /work/tmp/review-crate

cd /work/tmp/review-crate && RUSTUP_AUTO_INSTALL=0 cargo test --locked --features sync,future --test review_regressions -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 > /work/tmp/debug-regressions.log 2>&1; code=$?; cat /work/tmp/debug-regressions.log; exit "$code"
cd /work && ./clock && cd crate && diff -qr /work/crate /work/tmp/review-crate && true
